title: Throwable Tomatoes
description: Adds tomatoes.. Don't like something? Throw tomatoes at it!
body:
If you dont like something well then.... Throw **_tomatoes_** at it mercilessly!!

If you want to experice the power of **_tomatoes_** try this mod!
It's **simple** and very **easy** to craft!

Step by step instructions on how to make those tomatoes!
Step.1 Find some tall grass (not short grass) and then break it, it will give you **Tomato seeds**.
Step.2 Get **bonemeal**.
Step.3 Find sugarcane and turn it into **sugar**.
Step.4 Smelt the **sugar** and you'll get **Fertilizer**.
Step.5 Make a bucket and put water in it.
Step.6 Put the **bonemeal**, **fertilizer**, **water bucket** and the **tomato seed** into a _crafting table_.
Step.7 You have **_tomatoes_**!
Step.8 Throw it at stuff!

But if you perfer a video tutorial, Here you go!
